The University of Guelph, a research-intensive university in Ontario, awards a range of entrance scholarships to international students. The flagship Dr. Franco J. Vaccarino President's Scholarship is the university's most prestigious undergraduate entrance award for international students, paying $8,250 over four years plus a $9,500 stipend for a summer research position.

Programme Highlights

  • Flagship Dr. Franco J. Vaccarino President's Scholarship: $8,250 over four years plus a $9,500 stipend for a summer research position
  • A range of additional entrance awards for international students, varying by programme and admission average
  • One application platform handles most entrance awards (apply by 8 March 2027, 4:00 PM EST)
  • Reference letters for the President's Scholarship are due 15 March 2027

Who Should Apply

International students applying from secondary school to an undergraduate programme at Guelph for fall 2027. The President's Scholarship looks for top admission averages plus leadership, community involvement and research potential; most other entrance awards are automatic or short-form based on the admission file.

Funding and Costs

Awards reduce costs but rarely cover them fully — Guelph's international undergraduate tuition is roughly CAD $30,000–$42,000/year depending on programme, so plan funding as tuition minus awards plus living costs (Guelph is cheaper than Toronto housing by roughly 20–30%).

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply for admission first, then complete the entrance scholarship application in the Student Financial Services portal by 8 March 2027, 4:00 PM EST, and make sure your referees submit by 15 March 2027. Key deadline information: President's Scholarship 8 March 2027, 4:00 PM EST; reference letters 15 March 2027; other awards vary.

About University of Guelph

The University of Guelph is a research-intensive Canadian university in Ontario known for veterinary, agricultural, food and life sciences. Its President's Scholarship is the flagship entrance award for international undergraduate students.

Official website: https://www.uoguelph.ca

Contact

Questions about this scholarship, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official scholarship page (see the Official Link section above). Always include your applicant ID or programme name so the admissions or scholarship team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements and deadlines on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form — transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Deadlines shown in local time (CET/CEST) as published by the provider; convert to your own time zone before planning.
